# Frost Mage — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Build (levels 10-60), 10/0/41 — no respec, one build from level 10 to 60. The decision loop walks 112 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 38 (1 member), level 48 (2 members), level 51 (2 members), level 60 (15 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/mage/frost/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **GOOD** — 103% of the human spec median (233 vs 225.5 boss DPS over 113 boss fights) [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [frost.md](./frost.md).

## How the bots play it

## Abilities and when they are learned

The learn level is the first level the bot can have the ability: a trainer, starting, quest or item level from `kit.yaml`, or the talent point in the build above.

- **MF04p-polymorph-moon — Polymorph:** Polymorph-able is spell 118's own TargetCreatureType: beast (1), humanoid (7) or critter (8), so a Molten Elemental (4) is never marked and never sheeped here. Two branches, so it never re-casts on a sheep with time left: a mob with no sheep aura (any of the four ranks 118, 12824, 12825, 12826) is sheeped while two or more enemies are engaged on the party (the marked mob itself counts once it is awake and attacking, a sheeped one attacks nobody, so the second case needs one other enemy: the last mob standing is never sheeped); a mob that carries the sheep is sheeped again only under 3 s left (target.aura_ms, v17) and while at least one other enemy is engaged.
- **MF04s-polymorph-second — Polymorph:** `target: other_engaged` (v10), a hostile that attacks the resident and is not the target; beast, humanoid or critter only (spell 118's TargetCreatureType, as the party rule); two enemies engaged, none sheeped within 40 yd (one Polymorph per caster; Frost Nova, Arcane Explosion and the rest already carry `not sheeped_within`, so they do not break it); standing; 60 mana (rank 1) and 30 per cent of the bar.

- **MF07-frost-nova — Frost Nova:** Deadmines humanoids are freezable, so every Nova the mage cast on the tank's single target pulled that mob out of the tank's reach.
- **MF07p-frost-nova-freezable — Frost Nova:** FREEZABLE is read from the creature, not guessed: not root-immune (Nova is Mechanic 7, DB; target.mechanic_immune(7) is the creature_template mechanic_immune_mask and any aura immunity) and not frost-immune. PARTY SAFETY with v42 terms: not a boss (a boss that is frozen away from the tank is the case frost.md L95 forbids for the endgame loop), the tank has threat on it, its victim is not the healer, and no polymorphed or otherwise broken-by-damage CC within 12 yd (sheeped_within).
- **MF10m-remove-lesser-curse-must — Remove Lesser Curse:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.

- **MF16w-shoot-trash — Shoot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-065 (owner approved, via the orchestrator: the mage spends to empty on every trash fight, 28 of 56 fights under 20 per cent in round 86, and drinks after almost every pull; wand earlier on trash, keep full nukes for bosses and big pulls): the wand instead of a nuke when the target is under 30 per cent health, or the mage is under 40 per cent mana, in a fight that is not a boss or a big pull. Boss and big-pull test, from what a rule can read in combat: `not (target.ttd_ms >= 15000)` (a target the party will take 15 s or more to kill is a long fight; null reads true, so a fresh target is trash until it proves otherwise) and `enemies_engaged_within(30) <= 3` (a pack of four or more keeps the nukes and the area spells).
- **MF14s-fire-blast-frozen — Fire Blast:** The root aura is the Nova spell id itself (DB: 122, 865, 6131, 10230 carry aura 26 in effect 2), so the guard names all four ranks because the engine casts the highest rank known.
- **MF14-fire-blast — Fire Blast:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MF15s-fireball-slowed — Fireball:** HO-TKB-PLAY-270 (leveller pass; guide leveling.md L116-L117): below 10 Frostbolt is the slow and Fireball is the damage, so once the Frostbolt chill is on the target (R1 116, R2 205: effect aura 33, the aura id is the spell id, DB) the mage casts Fireball until the mob reaches it; MF15 still casts the Frostbolt when no chill is on.
- **MF15-frostbolt — Frostbolt:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand. HO-TKB-PLAY-189 (HO-188): not on Noxxion (13282, Razorfen Downs boss), whose creature_template school_immune_mask is 16 = frost `db:penqle_world.creature_template@tkbplay-189`; a stopgap until p1-loop's target.school_immune(k) (v40) lands, then it is replaced by the vocabulary term.
- **MF15a-fireball — Fireball:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MF16-shoot — Shoot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031): also while a ritual is on below 40 per cent mana (not on a boss), where the spenders hold back for the area wave. Measured on d-20260917T070130Z-p3, actor 358: the wand was 26 per cent of the mage''s casts, 86 per cent of its starts were unasked, 7 ticks were wand-locked, and 35 of its own casts came back SPELL_FAILED_INTERRUPTED -- the bot''s own movement cancelling its own auto-repeat.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **MF00e-conjure-food-2:** Out of combat, standing, never while a meal or a drink is running, and with a quarter of the pool left to pay for it.
- **MF00e-conjure-food-1:** Out of combat, standing, never while a meal or a drink is running, and with a quarter of the pool left to pay for it.
- **MF00d-conjure-water-2:** Out of combat, standing, never while a meal or a drink is running, and with a quarter of the pool left to pay for it.
- **MF00d-conjure-water-1:** Out of combat, standing, never while a meal or a drink is running, and with a quarter of the pool left to pay for it.
- **MF07p-frost-nova-freezable:** Not expressible and left to P270-5: whether the tank stands in melee with the mob (a tank that backs off leaves a rooted mob behind) and a mob other than the target that is hitting the healer.
- **MF11b-arcane-explosion-rooted:** MF11a needs three engaged within 10 yd; this rule allows two while the target carries a Frost Nova root (any rank: 122, 865, 6131, 10230, the aura is the spell id, DB tkbplay-360), so a rooted pair is not left to the Frostbolt.
